pages.title: Matrix Fibre
pages.text: Collagen, the rope that holds a body together: three chains wound round each other into a fibre stronger than steel for its weight. Found in collagen seams in Inner Space's tissue. The Regeneration Tank spins more from tissue and bone.

Made in $(item)Chemical Reactor$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Collagen Seam$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Macrophage.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Ribosome Workshop chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Collagen Seam, Extracellular Matrix, Grown Organ.
